''See also: [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon's Remnant arm]] is a white, skeletal prosthetic attached to his right side following the loss of his original limb. Created through [[Forging]] and scripting, the arm is composed of [[Gold]]-stage components and possesses a distinct, lifelike appearance that resembles three-dimensional paintings. While it can be shaped to have smooth fingertips rather than sharp claws, the limb retains a degree of independent will and often acts against [[Lindon]]'s direct commands. A defining characteristic of the arm is its intense, boundless [[hunger]]; it functions by consuming [[madra]] and essence, often behaving like a leech or a predator. This [[hunger]] can be managed through the use of scripted cloth, halfsilver ring{{!}}halfsilver rings to restrict its power, or hunger binding{{!}}hunger bindings taken from [[dreadbeasts]]. Despite being a prosthetic, the arm is integrated into [[Lindon's body]] to such an extent that its white material has begun to spread toward his chest. While the arm provides significant combat utility—such as acting as a shield, seizing objects with unnatural strength, or devouring enemy [[madra]]—it is physically taxing to use. It can suffer spiritual fractures and structural damage during intense combat, requiring repairs with [[hunger madra]] or specialized components to maintain its integrity.}}
